analysis: Changes are small and scheduling-only. (1) ProviderLoop+Capacity.swift line 82 adds `await checkSelectedModelRecoveryIfDue()` to the capacity tick, placed after refreshAutopilotInventoryRegistration and before superviseServingAuthorization/writeDaemonState. (2) ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift unloadModel: after a successful Nemotron Super retirement and after a normal unload, `selectedModelRecovery.makeAllDue(now: .now)` marks waiting selected models due for recheck at the next capacity tick. No new inputs, wire messages, key handling, plaintext paths, cache storage or authorization decisions are touched. The model-loading patch relies on the existing load path (ensureModelLoaded) for gating: autopilotServesModel, addon hold fence addonHoldLoadRefusal, memory admission, the GLM/MiMo checks and weight-hash verification. The recovery load is expected to go through that path, but the implementation of checkSelectedModelRecoveryIfDue and selectedModelRecovery is not in the supplied evidence (defined elsewhere in the PR or in unchanged files). Remaining integration questions: (a) whether the recovery check bypasses addonHoldLoadRefusal (TB-012/T-059) or the autopilot load ownership checks, and whether it loads models while serving authorization (TB-011/T-053) is revoked; (b) whether repeated makeAllDue on each unload could cause load/evict thrash with slot-cap eviction (an availability concern, T-029 class), since eviction-triggered unloads would immediately make waiting models due; the periodic tick bounds rate to one check per heartbeat/2. No concrete regression is evidenced in the supplied lines. The ModelLoading base text is truncated at line 552, so the full unload path was not viewable on the base side; only the patch hunks were examined.
